span.div:
─heartbeat-interval: 100ms (default)
─election-timeout: 1000ms (default, 10x
heartbeat)
etcd uses a conservative 1-second
election timeout because:
- Kubernetes clusters may have high load
on control plane
- etcd nodes may share CPU with other
components
- Stability of leader is more important
than fast failover
